notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - non VR and gamepad support
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

Over the past 8 months since the last update, I have been reworking the game architecture to better support VR and to add a non-VR play mode with full gamepad support.

WHAT IS NEW:

 non-VR mode with dedicated menus
 main VR mode works best when using OpenXR / SteamVR
 complete overhaul of the game logic to support both VR and non VR
 menu option for V-sync, which is ON by default
 new store page assets
 new playable character model
 basic save mode


WHAT WILL BE ADDED:

 more levels
 pickable for dragons
 traps, puzzle logic
 more biomes
 more languages
 more sounds, animation


WHAT WILL BE FIXED:

 VR icons are currently not correctly displaying inputs
 game over logic
 game score logic on level end
 minor position issues, when moving your characters


It would be very welcome, if at this stage you can inform me of any VR issues or general technical bugs. Thank you for your support!

GENERAL UPDATE FROM THE DEVELOPER

It took a long time, but from here on, the game will be updated more frequently with new levels, more tutorials, and other interactions!

The newest game build is currently very small and more open to feedback for those of you who are still interested in checking it out and providing your thoughts.

Stay tuned for more updates, and stay safe and healthy!


Cheers & thank you! Happy gaming!
Simon, Dragon Snack Developer

notes.title: Draco Dux - Early Access release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/ada423484488034e644deaeb0a7294d400c17293.png

DracoDux has finally released as an Early Access game!

This release has some basic levels, with core mechanics that will be mixed in future updates to create some interesting puzzle variations!

All four dragons are playable:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/b6a39da009573ea6cc6811200ba5449bc9c23201.png
Draco - controls like a standard third person character

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/dd243713c8b55c6f163929e9758f608f05ddfded.png
Dralth - point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - JUMP & DASH

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/09c19f55883a950aac0489bf42ee57c75be2c7ed.png
Hiradolth - point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - SHIELD & SLOW FALL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25115982/a0075cdad8756da5d11c29398e807bff50be3166.png
Tamolth -  point & click dragon wand controls, 2 abilities - BITE & FIREBALL

Visit Discord forum here:

https://discord.gg/fAjVRw3

You can share your feedback on bugs / other issues and help in further development ! 

YOUR FEEDBACK IS KEY and will definitely make the game better, nearing its final release. I'll make sure to read every comment and also post updates on further development here and on Discord.


If you want to know more about the game, please check my YT channel for video updates:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCucLRnBhW5lGXkN9GFjiPFA

You can also visit the games website:
https://dragonsnackproductions.com/

Take care and see you in VR space! []-)
